node.title: Re: Generalizing a REGEX
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You can anchor the regex to the end of the string with $. See [doc://perlrequick], [doc://perlretut], and [doc://perlre]. Note the /r modifier I'm using is only available in Perl 5.14 (from 2011) and up.

$ perl -le 'print for map { s/\.(\d+)$/($1)/r } qw/cat.1 ld.so.conf.5 /' cat(1) ld.so.conf(5)

Update: See also [id://1201201]
